outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: new settle_stale_gate(ctx, task), called first in start_task. It reads the plan through load_phase, asks _phases.stale_spelled_gates whether it names THIS task (finding text starts 'task <id>: '), and if so runs `audit-task.py settle <manifest> --project-dir` (cmd_settle: the one writer of derived values, under the lock, revalidated, journal row), then appends a did-line '<id>'s stale wide gate settled before its start: <old> -> <new>'. A task with an attempt, or not named, takes no settle call. A settle the verb refuses is a warning (warn(): did-line plus warnings) carrying the verb's words and the start goes on with the held wide gate, which measures more and never less. tests/test_drive_phase.py: new block ssg-block (_settle_stale_gate_cases) with ssg1 precondition (control derivation via real `settle` on a copy narrows to ['runner tests/test_a0.py'], basis tests.add; stale task holds ['true']/phase-no-spelling), ssg2 stale task settled before start (gate/basis equal the control's, verb order settle then start, did-line), ssg3 allow twin (attempt>0: only start runs, gate unchanged, no settled clause), ssg4 refused settle -> warning and start proceeds. Mutations (cmp-restored, __pycache__ purged each cycle): no stale check -> ssg3 red; settle after start -> ssg2 and ssg4 red; refusal stops the drive -> ssg4 red; restored 4/4. First sweep run had 12 reds from my first draft reading the manifest with _mio.load_manifest (unit rigs with a stub ctx whose manifest is not on disk); switched to load_phase, which those rigs stub; final full sweep green. Dependants: drive-without-model hook, _worktrees, and the tests importing drive-phase use no start_task signature that changed (signature unchanged, start_task still returns None or the stop) - still correct; the full sweep covers them. tests/test_drive_phase.py dependants (test_drive_without_model etc.) import helpers only; unchanged. CAVEATS: (1) `settle` is plan-wide, so the first start of a stale task also settles any other derived value the plan carries stale (it is the verb's whole job, same as /audit:phase settle); the did-line names only this task's gate. (2) The measurement harness's task gate changes for such a task: record as a measurement deviation. (3) OWED, NOT DONE: changelog fragment changelog.d/P172.6.changed.md - not in this task's files, so I stopped and name it.
